ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool Services Have Been Installed - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects service installation of different remote access tools software. These software are often abused by threat actors to perform Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceName = RGX(".*AmmyyAdmin.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*AnyDesk.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*Atera.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*BASupportExpressSrvcUpdater.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*BASupportExpressStandaloneService.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*chromoting.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*GoToAssist.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*GoToMyPC.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*jumpcloud.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*LMIGuardianSvc.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*LogMeIn.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*monblanking.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*Parsec.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*RManService.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*RPCPerformanceService.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*RPCService.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*SplashtopRemoteService.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*SSUService.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*TeamViewer.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*TightVNC.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*vncserver.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*Zoho.*")))
